description: This Kotlin source file defines a CalendarHandler class along with related data classes and interfaces for interacting with Android's calendar content provider. It handles reading and writing calendar events, including permission checks, event querying, and event creation, with a focus on converting JSON requests into calendar operations.

classes.name: CalendarHandler
classes.description: Main class handling calendar event queries and additions, managing permission checks, parsing JSON parameters, and interacting with the CalendarDataSource.

classes.name: SystemCalendarDataSource
classes.description: Singleton implementation of CalendarDataSource that interacts with Android's Calendar Provider to manage calendar events.

classes.name: CalendarEventsRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for fetching calendar events.

classes.name: CalendarAddRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for adding a new calendar event.

classes.name: CalendarEventRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a calendar event record fetched from the calendar provider.

methods.name: handleCalendarEvents
methods.description: Handles JSON request for retrieving calendar events; performs permission check and returns events as JSON.

methods.name: handleCalendarAdd
methods.description: Handles JSON request for adding a new calendar event; performs permission check, validation, and adds event.

methods.name: parseEventsRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into CalendarEventsRequest object, with default date range if none provided.

methods.name: parseAddRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into CalendarAddRequest object.

methods.name: parseISO
methods.description: Parses ISO-8601 date string into Instant.

methods.name: eventJson
methods.description: Converts a CalendarEventRecord into a JSON object.
